layout.arrangement: Title 'Recall' centered at top in large red text. Below it, a gray definition bar spans upper-left to center. Left column contains the Meaning section, recall formula box, two speech bubbles, and a bottom blue question box. Right column contains two confusion matrices stacked at top, a precision calculation box in the center, and two decision-tree diagrams at bottom right. Slide number '10' appears in a yellow circle at the top-right corner.

regions.name: definition bar
regions.content: Gray box with red underline: 'Correctly Classified (as Positive)' and 'Total objects that should be retrieved (Actually Positive)'

regions.name: meaning section
regions.content: 'Meaning' in red, followed by 'Does the classifier miss any of Positive Objects ?' with 'miss' in red and 'Positive' underlined in blue

regions.name: recall formula
regions.content: Red-outlined box containing 'Recall =' above a fraction 'TP / (TP + FN)'

regions.name: speech bubbles
regions.content: Two callout boxes: 'Positive Classified as +ive' and 'Positive Classified as -ive', with a green curly brace below labeled 'All Positive Samples in the Dataset'

regions.name: bottom question box
regions.content: Blue-outlined box: 'If you said: I picked ALL Positive objects, can I trust you ? At what %?'

regions.name: top confusion matrix
regions.content: 2x2 grid labeled 'Predicted as' with columns P/N and rows Actual P/N; cells contain TP (green), FN, FP, TN (green)

regions.name: numeric confusion matrix
regions.content: 2x2 grid labeled 'Predicted as' with circled values: 18 (purple), 12 (orange), 10, 60 (green)

regions.name: decision trees
regions.content: Two trees under red 'Positive' header and green 'Negative' header; Positive tree root 30 (red) branches to TP 18 (red) and FN 12 (green); Negative tree root 70 (green) branches to TN 60 (green) and FP 10 (red)

layout.hierarchy: Title dominates visually (largest, red, centered). Definition bar and Meaning section are secondary. Recall formula and decision trees are prominent visual anchors. Bottom question box and precision box are smaller supporting elements.

visual_elements.description: Top-right confusion matrix: header 'Predicted as', column headers P and N, row header 'Actual' with row labels P and N. Cell (P,P) contains 'TP' on green background. Cell (P,N) contains 'FN'. Cell (N,P) contains 'FP'. Cell (N,N) contains 'TN' on green background.

Middle-right confusion matrix: header 'Predicted as', column headers P and N, row header 'Actual' with row labels P and N. Cell (P,P) contains '18' inside a purple circle. Cell (P,N) contains '12' inside an orange circle. Cell (N,P) contains '10'. Cell (N,N) contains '60' inside a green circle.

Bottom-right two decision trees. Left tree under red header 'Positive': root node red circle '30', left branch to red circle '18' labeled 'TP', right branch to green circle '12' labeled 'FN'. Right tree under green header 'Negative': root node green circle '70', left branch to green circle '60' labeled 'TN', right branch to red circle '10' labeled 'FP'.
Red-outlined rounded rectangle containing the Recall formula.
Blue-outlined rectangle containing the bottom trust question.

Two speech-bubble callouts pointing to small boxes: 'Positive Classified as +ive' and 'Positive Classified as -ive', with a green curly brace underneath spanning both labeled 'All Positive Samples in the Dataset'.

typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout. Title is large, bold, red, all-caps style. Body text is regular black sans-serif. Emphasis words like 'Meaning' and 'miss' are in red. 'Positive' in the meaning question is underlined in blue. No numbered bullets; content is organized in boxes and sections.
animation_state: All elements appear static and fully revealed; no mid-build indicators visible.
